gapThisFills: 2023-24 Upper Deck Extended Series Hockey is the SINGLE BIGGEST named hole in this re-key run (345 stored sales in 2023-24 alone, examples cited: Champs Rookies #C-19, Silver Skates #SS-20, Beehive #BH-xx) and had NO staged checklist anywhere in the repo before this package. Beckett's S3 origin has a file (2024/06/2023-24-Upper-Deck-Extended-Series-Hockey-Checklist.xlsx, HTTP 200, sha256 f9ccedf8c72d7267016a3d6c160cf4ad748291008af78124338f20270215d87e) but its Inserts/Autographs sheets carry the same odds-line-before-'Parallels:' layout defect already documented and rejected for the 2022-23 Extended Series and 2023-24 Series 2 sibling packages (measured directly: converting it with convertBeckettChecklistXlsx.cjs as-is minted category names like 'insert-16-hobby-16-e-pack-16-blaster-16-hanger-packs' instead of 'Beehive' or 'Silver Skates' -- the real insert names never survived the conversion). CardboardConnection has no page under the guessed slug for this year (2023-24-upper-deck-extended-series-hockey-cards, confirmed 404 by WebFetch). upperdeck.com's own checklist page (source #3) publishes the full table as static server-rendered HTML, same shape as the 2023-24 Series 2 and 2024-25 Extended Series sibling packages, and was used here.
converterNote: Same one-off HTML-table parser used for the 2023-24 Series 2 sibling package (reads <thead> column names rather than assuming position; groups rows by the table's own Set Name; folds a Set Name group onto another when their (cardNumber -> player) maps agree on every shared number). Not committed as a script -- lives in the builder's scratch directory. If this source is used again, it belongs in its own committed script.

r67Verification.rule: A Set Name group folds onto an anchor only when its (cardNumber -> player) map agrees with the anchor's on every number it has (exact match for same-size groups; clean SUBSET match, 0 disagreements and 0 missing numbers, for a smaller group against a larger anchor -- the same contract used for 'Oversized Parallel - Young Guns' in the 2023-24 Series 2 sibling package and documented elsewhere in this repo for Beckett's 'Hobby Exclusive' roster fold).
r67Verification.cleanFolds: 50 same-size anchor/parallel groups matched automatically (Base Set and its 4 subset anchors -- All-Star Team, Checklist, Young Guns, 1st Round Rookies, Young Guns Checklist -- each with 7 colour parallels; every named retro/insert product -- 1997-98 SPx Holoview Retros, 1998-99 UD3, 2003-04 Beehive (plus its Rookies split), 2007-08 Black Diamond Retros (4 star tiers x plain/rookie), 2008-09 Upper Deck Retro (plus Young Guns split), Dazzlers Blue, HoloGrFx Future Fame, HoloGrFx Rookies, Population Count 1000, Seeing Red, Silver Skates, UD Canvas (plus Checklist/Young Guns/Legends/NHL All-Star subsets) -- each with its own colour/finish parallels). 4 more were added by hand after the planner's first run flagged them as unregistered SUBSET folds (same shape as Oversized in the Series 2 package): Snow Spray Auto Variations (17 rows, all against Base Set), Swagnificent Photo Variations (14 rows, all against Base Set), Penalty Box Photo Variations (14 rows, SPLIT 11 against Base Set + 3 against Base Set - All-Star Team -- a single named variation set drawing its subjects from two different base subsets, each row folds to whichever anchor actually has that card number), All-Star Skills Photo Variations (14 rows, all against Base Set - All-Star Team). All four were verified with 0 disagreements and 0 missing numbers before folding; each was written into its anchor's category with the source's own variation name in the parallel column (Snow Spray Auto Variation / Swagnificent Photo Variation / Penalty Box Photo Variation / All-Star Skills Photo Variation).
r67Verification.genuinelyOwnCards: Acetate Young Guns (98 rows, cardNumbers 201-298) does NOT match Base Set - Young Guns's numbering (701-729 base range) or any other anchor at all -- 0 agreements checked directly. The source's own description confirms why: this insert 'combines the 98 Young Guns from Series One and Two plus 29 new [Extended] Young Guns' under its own renumbering, i.e. its numbering is a cross-product roster, not a rung of any single base subset. Hockey Heroes (HH-, 40 rows), The NHL Specialists (NS-, 20 rows), Special Forces (SF-, 20 rows), and Day With The Cup (DC, 11 rows) all carry their own number prefixes with no base overlap by inspection -- own-cards, no fold candidate, no collision. planStagedDirectory does NOT flag any of these for registration (verdict 'pass', 0 unregistered keys) -- a category only needs a productSetKeys entry when the planner finds an actual cell-level collision to resolve (as happened for 'PC's' vs 'Population Count 1000' in the 2023-24 Series 2 sibling package); an unambiguous own-numbering insert with no clash needs no key at all. No registrations are needed for this package.

heldExceptions.rule: Three UD Canvas card numbers had a genuine, unresolvable data discrepancy on upperdeck.com's own page -- the SAME card number naming a DIFFERENT player (or carrying a marker inconsistency) between its plain section and its own stated parallel section. Per this build's 'never synthesize' instruction, neither value was guessed as correct; all rows for the 3 affected numbers were DROPPED rather than folded or arbitrarily kept.
